title: Architecture decision — dual-write vs event-driven
prompt: When a shipment is received, we currently update the shipment row and the inventory ledger in two writes inside one transaction. Consider replacing with an event-driven approach (outbox + consumer). Produce an ADR comparing the two approaches on correctness, observability, blast radius, and migration cost.

hard_gates.name: context-stated
hard_gates.description: Why now? what triggered this decision?

hard_gates.name: consequences-named
hard_gates.description: Positive AND negative consequences of the decision
